title: Analysis code for: Estimating the Effect of Respiratory Rate on Patient Condition Using a State-Space Model in a University Hospital Setting
description: R/Stan code for a Bayesian state-space model that estimates latent severity from irregularly recorded general-ward vital signs before unplanned ICU admission, relates the 24-h mean severity to 30-day mortality, and assesses each vital sign by leave-one-channel-out and single-channel refits. No patient data are included.
